title: 200 mile highway range
requirement: 200 mi at 70 mph baseline; claim conditions open
closure_evidence: Measured road load, usable energy and full-distance test

title: 125+ mph top speed
requirement: Strictly above 125 mph; duration/SOC conditions open
closure_evidence: Mapped drive and closed-course speed/thermal test

title: Tesla charging
requirement: Actual authorized station use, not only connector fit
closure_evidence: Network eligibility and successful approved-site AC/DC sessions

title: Complete bike mass
requirement: Less than 400 lb; no relaxed ceiling approved
closure_evidence: Configuration-specific reconciled BOM and calibrated weighing

title: Highway comfort and wind confidence
requirement: 77 mph design speed; quantified comfort/handling limits open
closure_evidence: Rider trials, aero moments and closed-course handling

title: Broad rider fit
requirement: Adjustable comfortable ordinary upright posture; population bounds open
closure_evidence: Adjustable buck with measured rider sample and gear

title: Appearance variants
requirement: Common body in matte black/silver/tan; physical standards open
closure_evidence: Owner visual review and physical finish samples

title: Optional saddlebags
requirement: Discreet removable mounts; capacity/rating open
closure_evidence: Structural proof/fatigue, loaded handling/clearance/aero

title: Independent friction braking
requirement: Required stopping/fade with zero regenerative braking
closure_evidence: Applicable brake tests in regen unavailable cases

title: Unintended torque prevention
requirement: Demand plausibility, torque arbitration and fault response defined
closure_evidence: Safety analysis, HIL and fault-injection evidence

title: HV protection
requirement: Touch/isolation/overcurrent protection across full fault envelope
closure_evidence: Coordination study and instrumented fault/environmental tests

title: Charge/drive exclusion
requirement: No propulsion while connected; safe AC/DC route selection
closure_evidence: Interlock/state-machine faults and physical integration tests

title: Thermal capability
requirement: Cell/drive limits at speed and stationary charging; ambient envelope open
closure_evidence: Calibrated heat rejection model and thermal tests

title: Pack retention and fault containment
requirement: Impact/fatigue/vent/seal/swelling boundaries defined
closure_evidence: Supplier cell data, structural analysis and pack tests

title: Dynamic clearance
requirement: No contact throughout motion/tolerance envelope; numerical margins open
closure_evidence: Steer/bump/lean/drive/gear/service swept CAD and physical checks

title: Structural durability
requirement: GVWR/duty spectrum must precede strength and fatigue limits
closure_evidence: Correlated FEA, coupons, weld/joint and rig tests

title: Serviceability
requirement: Pack removal, fault isolation and normal service by defined equipment
closure_evidence: Dry-run access/removal and released service instructions

title: Road equipment
requirement: Complete lamps/reflectors/mirrors/horn/instruments/plate equipment
closure_evidence: Jurisdiction matrix and installation compliance tests

title: Service life and battery retention
requirement: Life, cycles, calendar aging and range retention limits unset
closure_evidence: Owner limits then supplier/vehicle aging evidence

title: Market compliance
requirement: US-first study; sales markets and classification need confirmation
closure_evidence: Current applicability review and required compliance records

title: Configuration reproducibility
requirement: Every installed part revision/calibration/finish and deviation traceable
closure_evidence: Build configuration audit against serialized unit

title: Software release
requirement: Versioned source/configuration, compatible firmware and reproducible artifacts
closure_evidence: Reviewed releases, checksums, HIL/integration evidence

title: EMC
requirement: No unsafe disturbance or excess emissions under applicable regime
closure_evidence: Harness-aware EMC precompliance and required final tests

title: Environmental durability
requirement: Rain/wash/salt/vibration/temperature limits to be set
closure_evidence: Rated component installation and vehicle environmental tests

title: Supply assurance
requirement: Actual specified cell, motor and safety systems obtainable and supported
closure_evidence: Dated supplier confirmations/configured quotations

title: Low voltage reserve
requirement: Critical controls and fault response survive defined DC/DC failures
closure_evidence: LV load/duration budget and brownout tests

title: 120 V AC charging
requirement: Do not claim until exact OBC input supports it
closure_evidence: Datasheet/configuration and charge tests at selected supply

title: Range claim definition
requirement: Temperature, wind, payload, SOH, reserve and repeatability set before claim
closure_evidence: Approved claim protocol and traceable evidence

title: Low-SOC drive capability
requirement: Power/speed/derating across loaded voltage window, not nominal only
closure_evidence: Dynamometer map with loaded pack constraints

title: Brake thermal endurance
requirement: Repeated stops at defined load/speed/interval without unacceptable fade
closure_evidence: Instrumented fade/recovery test and rotor/pad limits

title: Incoming traceability
requirement: Cell lots, safety hardware, materials and firmware tied to build
closure_evidence: Incoming acceptance and serialized traveler

title: Payload and GVWR
requirement: Rated rider/luggage/passenger and axle loads unset
closure_evidence: Owner decision plus load/tire/structure/brake reconciliation

title: Finish durability
requirement: Paint/seat/panel durability and repair criteria unset
closure_evidence: Physical coupons, weathering, cleaning and abrasion tests

title: Diagnostics and security
requirement: Gloved local fault indication; no remote/cloud dependency for safety
closure_evidence: Threat/fault analysis and diagnostic access tests

title: Manufacturing definition
requirement: Every custom part drawing/process/inspection and joint specification released
closure_evidence: First article and manufacturing readiness review
